reviews.text: the rom&nd Blur Fudge Tint is a versatile lip product that’s perfect for anyone looking for a natural yet polished lip look. Whether you’re aiming for an everyday subtle tint or a more intense lip color, this product delivers both performance and comfort. It’s definitely a worthy addition to your makeup collection if you love a natural, blurred finish.
reviews.zh: rom&nd Blur Fudge Tint係一支多功能嘅唇部產品，啱晒想搵自然但又精緻唇妝嘅人。無論你係想日常淡淡嘅唇色定係更加濃郁嘅唇色，呢款產品都做到效果同舒適兼備。如果你鍾意自然嘅霧面妝效，絕對值得加入你嘅化妝收藏。

reviews.text:
I loveee this formula so much, because it’s a non-drying matte lip formula, like a lip mud. (I’m a HUGE lip product gal)
I ordered shade 07 after trying shade 02 and loving it!!

Would definitely recommend to those looking for that blurred lip effect or a non-drying matte lip. Very smudgable formula, doesn’t make lip lines stand out very much imo. I use a lip brush to blur the edges of my lips.
Velvety application, applies smoothly.
Pigmented, you don’t need to use much product to get a nice color. It lasts quite long too in comparison with other rom&nd lip products — just let the product settle on your lips and dry out. It doesn’t transfer too much, but isn’t transfer-proof.
It’s not very drying but it’s not very moisturizing either, so keep that in mind before you purchase. 

In terms of color, 07 is more cool toned compared to 02, and is more of a muted tulip color. I attached some swatch pictures I found online for shade comparisons.

Hope this was helpful~~
reviews.zh:
我超級鍾意呢個配方，因為佢係一支唔乾嘅霧面唇釉，好似唇泥咁。（我係唇妝產品控）
試完02號色好鍾意，所以再order咗07號色！！

想搵霧面唇妝效果或者唔乾嘅霧面唇妝嘅人，我一定會推薦。配方好易blend，我個人覺得唇紋都唔會太突出。我會用唇刷去blur唇邊。
上嘴絲滑，搽得好順。
顯色度高，唔需要用好多已經有好靚嘅顏色。比起其他rom&nd唇妝產品，持久度都幾高——等佢settle喺嘴唇上面乾返就OK。唔會轉移得太勁，但都唔係完全唔甩色。
唔算好乾但亦都唔算好保濕，所以買之前要留意呢點。

顏色方面，相比02號，07號更加冷調，係比較啞緻嘅鬱金香色。揾咗網上啲試色圖片貼上嚟畀大家參考。

希望幫到你～

reviews.text: I purchased two colors, current jam and cool rose up. They blurred nicely on the lips however when on first application without blurring it came out a bit patchy. So I have to always blur it out with my fingers. It has a slight velvety texture but felt slightly more drying that I hoped. The lasting power was okay.
reviews.zh: 買咗兩隻色，current jam同cool rose up。blend完之後上唇效果好靚，不過第一次直接上嘴唔blend嘅話會有少許斑駁。所以我每次都要用手指去blend開。有少許絲絨觸感，但係比我想像中更加乾。持久度就一般。

reviews.text: Really pretty color but it would definitely be better suited towards those who have a light skin tone or have cold under tones. I have light brown skin and I might be able to make it work when used very lightly. Overall, the texture is very soft and it has a chocolate like scent to it. It definitely lives up to its name of Blur as the application is beautiful! Would definitely use this type of lip tint if you want to do a gradient lip look!
reviews.zh: 顏色真係好靚，但係比較啱淺色皮膚或者冷調膚色嘅人。我係淺棕膚色，要用得好薄先用得嚟。整體質地好柔軟，有朱古力味。佢真係做到「Blur」呢個名，個上嘴效果好靚！如果想化漸層唇妝，一定會用呢類唇釉！

reviews.text: I’m warm tone, and these colors “Pomeloco” and “Radwoo” look gorgeous on my lips. The formula isn’t drying at all, however it’s winter season now and my lips are usually dry. I’ve tried romand “Velvety” and “Semi-matte Hanbok collection” tints, but these blur fudge tints are my absolute favorite 🥰 and it’s super easy to bland it on lips without a brush for a soft gradient effect
reviews.zh: 我係暖調膚色，「Pomeloco」同「Radwoo」呢兩隻色上我嘴唇好靚。配方完全唔乾，不過而家係冬天，我嘴唇平時都好乾。之前試過romand「Velvety」同「Semi-matte Hanbok collection」嘅唇釉，但係呢款Blur Fudge Tint係我最愛🥰，唔使唇刷都好容易blend出柔和漸層效果。

reviews.text: Favorite lip product so far. rom&nd never disappoints with their lip product, but this one is the best yet. The texture is very smooth and velvety and it looks like I have filter on. It smudges really well, but it doesn't come off on the mask. I recommend you watch swatching video before you purchase.
reviews.zh: 到目前為止最鍾意嘅唇妝產品。rom&nd嘅唇妝產品從來都冇令我失望，但呢支係最出色嘅。質地好滑好絲絨，望落好似有filter咁。blend得好靚，但又唔會黐喺口罩度。建議買之前睇下試色片。

reviews.text:
Finally a neutral mlbb COOL tone pink that doesn't actually lean warm, is muted enough so it doesn't look offensively neon without carrying grey tone reminiscent of dead barbie pink, but is actually bright enough so I don't look sick ( ´ ▽ ` )ﾉ * ~
The texture feels matte out of the tube, it's almost like spreading a thicker mac powder kiss with more pigment that also FIXES fast. It srsly doesn't budge, and isn't drying at all for how good that blur is. chef's kiss (っ˘з(˘⌣˘ ) ♡
reviews.zh:
終於有一支中性mlbb冷調粉，唔會偏向暖調，啞緻得嚟唔會好似螢光色咁搶眼，但又唔會帶灰調似死人barbie粉，不過又夠光亮唔會望落好似病咗 ( ´ ▽ ` )ﾉ * ~
質地一擠出嚟就係霧面，幾乎好似搽厚咗少少嘅mac powder kiss，但顯色度仲要高，而且FIX得好快。真係一啲都唔甩，blur得咁靚但一啲都唔乾。完美 (っ˘з(˘⌣˘ ) ♡
